results.title: Twitter, Inc. is now X Corp. | TechCrunch
excerpts:
# Twitter, Inc. is now X Corp.
Elon Musk, who [purchased Twitter](https://techcrunch.com/2023/04/11/elon-musks-twitter-everything-you-need-to-know-from-layoffs-to-verification/) for $44 billion last year, has aspired to build what he calls “ [X, the everything app](https://twitter.com/elonmusk/status/1577428272056389633) .” This proposed
app [might look like](https://techcrunch.com/2022/10/08/elon-musk-x-everything-wechat-tesla-app/) China’s WeChat, which supports messaging, payments, ridesharing, food delivery and other services all in one app.
Musk has applauded WeChat for its convenience and utility, yet its unique dominance could be [impossible to replicate](https://techcrunch.com/2022/10/08/elon-musk-x-everything-wechat-tesla-app/) outside of China.

...

This move could be seen as the next step toward Musk building his super app, but the mogul does not have a great [track record](https://techcrunch.com/2023/02/16/tesla-recalls-362758-vehicles-over-fsd-beta-software-safety-concerns/) with following through on his plans. Yet the name change is not unprecedented.
As CEO of Tesla, Musk has shown that vertical integration is well-loved page in his playbook — just look [how many subsidiaries](https://www.secinfo.com/dsVsw.E1Ce.c.htm) the car company has.

...

# Elon Musk forms 3 companies in Nevada, filings show
Filings show the Tesla CEO and owner of Twitter is listed as director of X Holdings Corp., X Corp. and X.AI Corp.
Elon Musk departs the Phillip Burton Federal Building and United States Court House in San Francisco on Jan. 24, 2023. (AP Photo/Benjamin Fanjoy)
More Stories

...

Elon Musk is linked to three newly-formed Nevada companies, according to documents recently filed with the Nevada Secretary of State.
Filings show the Tesla CEO and owner of Twitter is listed as director of X Holdings Corp. and X Corp., both registered to a Carson City address.
The third company, X.AI Corp., is registered to a Las Vegas address, and names Jared Birchall as its secretary. Birchall is reported by the Wall Street Journal to be the same individual who manages Musk’s family office.

...

Earlier this month, Twitter Inc. was merged with [shell firm X Corp.](https://www.reviewjournal.com/business/musk-merges-twitter-with-nevada-based-company-whats-next-2760157/)
Twitter “no longer exists” after being merged with X Corp., according to an April 4 document submitted in a California court for a lawsuit filed against the company and its former chief executive officer, Jack Dorsey, last year by conservative activist Laura Loomer.
